comments.moved: {url} was merged by {by} ({sha}); the task moved to {stage}
comments.waiting: {url} was merged ({sha}); the task moves when these repositories merge too: {projects}
comments.out_of_order: {url} was merged ({sha}) while the task was still in {stage}, before any stage that opens a PR; it stays where it is
comments.deferred: {url} was merged ({sha}) while an agent was working on the task; it moves to {stage} when the run ends
comments.other_branch: {url} was merged into {base}, not {default}: nothing was recorded for the release
comments.other_head: {url} was merged from {head}, not from the task branch {branch}: nothing was recorded and the task stays where it is

log.save_sha: save the merge commit of task {task}
log.reconcile_list: list the tasks of board {board} to look for merged PRs
log.reconciled: merged PRs: read {read}, found {merged} merged, moved {moved} tasks
